title: Neural Networks: Zero to Hero (Karpathy)
hook: Andrej Karpathy builds neural nets from nothing — line by line in code — until you've coded your own working GPT. Free.
key_points: A free video course by Andrej Karpathy that builds neural networks from scratch in code.
It starts with micrograd, a tiny autograd engine, so you truly see backprop work.
It climbs step by step up to building a working GPT-style language model.
Hands-on and code-first — the best practical path for learning by doing, not just watching.
content_html: "Neural Networks: Zero to Hero" is a free video course by Andrej Karpathy that teaches deep learning by building it from scratch in code. It opens with micrograd, a minimal automatic-differentiation engine, so you implement backpropagation yourself, and it progresses all the way to constructing a working GPT-style model.
extra_html:
How it works

Each lesson writes code live, starting small and adding one idea at a time. By first coding a tiny autograd engine, you internalize how gradients flow before touching any framework. Later videos build language models character by character, layering in the components that make up a transformer, so the abstractions never feel like black boxes.

Why it matters

Watching explanations only gets you so far; implementing the pieces yourself is what makes them stick. Karpathy's course is widely recommended precisely because it bridges intuition and real code, taking you from "I sort of get backprop" to "I built a GPT." It's an ideal next step after grasping how networks learn.
